title: 第20章 很强吗第21章 落幕
lines: 江天逸此刻的面色也是极为难看，他有些难以置信，自己几乎倾尽全力的一击竟然就被这样轻易的化解了吗？
“龙虎血脉很强吗？”
江玄握了握手掌，有些轻蔑的笑道。
而在他话音落下之下，所有的人都能够感觉到江玄身上的变化，只见他的身体之内，一道道苍劲古老的龙吟声顿时响彻天地。
刹那间，只见无数金色光芒在江玄体内爆发，在天际之上化为一条条金色神龙虚影，无尽龙威威压而下，仿佛睥睨天下的君王！“这”江家高层一个个瞪大了眼睛，或许这些江家晚辈并不知晓这是什么，但作为天水郡的大人物，他们怎么会不知道！“灵气破体！这是真元境界的强者才能够达到的吧！”
“这江玄不过才多少？
开脉境八重！竟然已经能够达到这般地步了吗？”
江天有些震撼，他原本觉得江天逸的刚刚表现出来的龙虎血脉已经让他颇为满意了，哪料到这一转眼的功夫，这江玄表现出的天赋竟比江天逸更强！“呜！”
这时，在江玄的这股威压下，江天逸体内的龙虎血脉像是受到了压制，他的面色苍白，想要挣扎，却是发现自己竟然动都不能动！那是绝对的压制！其实，他并不知道江玄如今释放的龙威其实还不足全部的三成，若是日后他的九星神龙诀能够修至大成，恐怕一个威压就足以让江天逸毁灭！“江天逸，你刚刚说过我江玄将你江天逸视为对手，抢你的女人，我只能说你想太多了！”
“一个水性杨花的女人，你以为我会在乎？”
“还有，我江玄从来没有将你视为对手，一个连我的气息都承受不起的人，你也配？”
这一刻，江玄开口，语气中带着一丝讥讽！“你”“啊！”
江天逸面色铁青，刚想开口，但一阵骨骼碎裂的声音顿时传出，痛的江天逸惨叫一声，那是江玄的脚踩在了他的一条大腿上。
看着被自己踩在脚下的江天逸，江玄脸上没有丝毫的怜悯，有的只是讥讽的笑容。
而场下的众人只感到一阵唏嘘，这前一刻还高高在上的江天逸如今却被当成狗一般被踩在了脚底下。
而江雪更是身子一软，坐在地上，她的神情恍惚，似乎是在自嘲。
“现在的我们早已不在同一个阶层，这样的你就像小丑一样，只会让我更加的厌恶。”
“废物，我看你能够嚣张到几时？”
当初的话如今犹言在耳，不过现在想想是多么可笑，或许自己才是那个跳梁小丑吧！那个少年从未在乎，因为不屑！“江天逸，把我江玄作为敌人，是一生做的最错的一个决定！”
江玄冷笑一声，脚掌抬起，就要废了江天逸。
“放肆！”
不过就在这时，高台上的三长老江穹怒吼一声，他的身影掠出，冲向了擂台。
江穹乃是真元境一重的顶尖高手，速度何等之快，只一瞬间就到了擂台之上，可怕的一掌瞬间落下，拍向江玄的头顶！“哼！”
江玄原本踩下的脚掌立即收回，随后手掌一拍地面，借助着这股反震力退后了半米。
content_en:
Jiang Tianyi's face looked extremely ugly at the moment. He was a little unbelievable. Was the blow that he almost exerted all his strength to be resolved so easily?
"Is the dragon-tiger bloodline very strong?"
Jiang Xuan shook his hands and smiled contemptuously.
"Ang!"
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone could feel the changes in Jiang Xuan's body, and within his body, powerful ancient dragon roars suddenly resounded throughout the world.
In an instant, countless golden rays of light erupted in Jiang Xuan's body, turning into phantoms of golden divine dragons on the sky. The endless dragon power came down with pressure, as if looking down on the king of the world! "This" the senior officials of the Jiang family all widened their eyes. Maybe these juniors of the Jiang family don't know what this is, but as big shots in Tianshui County, how could they not know! "Aura breaks the body! This is something only a strong person in the True Yuan realm can achieve!"
"How young is Jiang Xuan?
The eighth level of the pulse opening realm! Has it actually reached this point? "
Jiang Tian was a little shocked. He originally thought that Jiang Tianyi's dragon-tiger bloodline that he had just shown had satisfied him. Who would have expected that in this blink of an eye, Jiang Xuan's talent would be even stronger than Jiang Tianyi's! "Woo!"
At this time, under Jiang Xuan's pressure, the dragon and tiger blood in Jiang Tianyi's body seemed to be suppressed. His face turned pale and he wanted to struggle, but he found that he could not move! That is absolute suppression! In fact, he didn't know that the dragon power released by Jiang Xuan now was actually less than 30% of the total. If his Nine-Star Divine Dragon Art could reach perfection in the future, I am afraid that one pressure would be enough to destroy Jiang Tianyi! "Jiang Tianyi, you just said that I, Jiang Xuan, regard you, Jiang Tianyi, as my rival and want to steal your woman. I can only say that you are thinking too much!"
"A woman who is so frivolous, do you think I care?"
"Also, I, Jiang Xuan, have never regarded you as an opponent. A person who can't even bear my breath, are you worthy?"
At this moment, Jiang Xuan spoke with a hint of sarcasm in his tone! "You" "Ah!"
Jiang Tianyi's face was livid, and he was about to speak, but the sound of broken bones suddenly came out, and Jiang Tianyi screamed in pain. It was Jiang Xuan's foot that stepped on one of his thighs.
Looking at Jiang Tianyi who was trampled under his feet, Jiang Xuan showed no mercy at all, only a sarcastic smile.
But everyone in the audience felt a sigh of relief. Jiang Tianyi, who was so high and mighty just a moment ago, was now being trampled under his feet like a dog.
Jiang Xue softened even more and sat on the ground, her expression in a daze, as if she was laughing at herself.
"We are no longer in the same class now. You are like a clown, which will only make me more disgusted."
"Trash, how long can you be arrogant?"
The original words still ring in my ears now, but now I think about how ridiculous they are. Maybe I am the clown! That boy never cared because he was disdainful! "Jiang Tianyi, treating me, Jiang Xuan, as your enemy is the worst decision you have ever made in your life!"
Jiang Xuan sneered, raised the soles of his feet, and was about to destroy Jiang Tianyi.
"Presumptuous!"
But at this moment, the third elder Jiang Qiong on the high platform roared angrily, and his figure rushed out and rushed towards the ring.
Jiang Qiong is a top master of the first level of the True Yuan Realm. He is so fast that he is on the stage in just an instant. A terrifying palm falls instantly and hits Jiang Xuan on the head! "Hmph!"
Jiang Xuan immediately retracted the sole of his foot that he originally stepped on, then slapped the ground with his palm, and retreated half a meter with the help of the counter-shock force.
